description: The units every install has. The program ships this file; it is read first and your own manifest is merged over it. Roots are named by KEY (orchestrator, claude, codex, grok, projects, home) and never by a path, so the same file is right on every machine. Your manifest may add entries and extend an entry's exclude and append_only lists; it cannot remove an entry from here (that is reported and ignored).

entries.note: The hub folder itself. Pages a machine draws for itself carry that machine's own paths, so they are generated locally rather than carried. append_only names the files two machines only ever ADD lines to: a both-sides change there is merged line by line instead of being flagged. Every other file, STATUS.md included, still conflicts and is left untouched.
Sessions are machine-local and account-local: each machine owns its own file and its own board.
Path-free, so it is safe to carry.
Drift is shown by `sync status` and NEVER applied: permissions, hook paths and models are machine-specific.
One vendor's global rules file. It needs a `codex` root in machine.json; without one the entry is skipped and says so.
One vendor's routing instructions only. Credentials, native memory, configuration and raw sessions stay local.

memories.note: <claude root>/projects/<munged>/memory/ <-> claude-home/memories/<logical>/. 'root' + 'rel' let the other machine re-munge to its own paths from its own roots; 'munged' records what each machine calls the folder. Only project folders that HAVE a memory/ subfolder are carried. The map itself is yours: it lives in your manifest, written by the tool, never by hand.

never_synced: credentials, tokens, API keys, keychains or .credentials of any kind
session transcripts, session-env, shell snapshots, telemetry and caches
machine.json, installed.json and .sync-state.json (this machine's identity and bookkeeping)
the pages each machine draws for itself (board*.html, tree.html, improvements.html) — regenerate them locally
your project repositories themselves — each travels by its own git remote; `sync status` only names the ones with unpushed work
<claude root>/settings.json (copied one-way to settings.reference.json for comparison, never applied)
